overview_description.description: ChipAgents is reinventing semiconductor design and verification through advanced AI agent techniques. Alpha Design AI is pioneering an AI-native approach to Electronic Design Automation (EDA), transforming how chips are designed and verified. Our flagship product, ChipAgents, aims to boost RTL design and verification productivity by 10x, driving innovation across industries with smarter, more efficient chip design.

product.name: ChipAgents Platform
product.description: An agentic AI environment that integrates with chip design workflows to accelerate RTL design, verification, and debugging.

product.name: ChipAgents
product.description: A tool that automates chip design, debugging, and verification processes, enhancing productivity and scalability for hardware engineers.

product.name: ChipAgents Root Cause Analysis (ChipAgents RCA)
product.description: An agentic AI tool for automated root cause analysis of ASIC bugs using error logs and waveforms.

product.name: Waveform Agents
product.description: AI agents that analyze waveform data to assist with debugging and linking observed behavior to underlying circuit logic.

product.name: CoverAgent
product.description: An AI agent that supports functional coverage analysis and testbench improvements for verification workflows.
